name: zod
featureGoal: Trace how a Zod schema validates a value through _parse and turns a failed check into a ZodError.
answers: I think z.string() builds a ZodString object, and calling .parse() on it runs an internal _parse that checks the value's type and throws a ZodError listing every failed check.
The error messages come from an issue map in the schema — each check adds an issue with a code like invalid_type, and ZodError formats them with the path to the failing field.
I am not sure how custom refinements and transforms fit in — whether they run inside the same _parse pipeline or after it.

name: hono
featureGoal: Trace how an incoming HTTP request is routed through Hono to its handler and how middleware wraps that handler.
answers: A request comes in through app.fetch, Hono looks up the matched route in the router, then runs the handler with a Context that wraps the request and response.
Middleware are composed left-to-right so each one can short-circuit before the handler runs, like a Koa onion model.
I think the router is a trie mapping method + path patterns to handlers, but I am not sure how it handles path params.
